name: screem
description: Transmissão de tela, câmera e reuniões para o Acelera DEV

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @screem/api && npm run build -w @screem/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @screem/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @screem/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @screem/api && npm run typecheck -w @screem/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @screem/api && npm test -w @screem/web
